checks.explanation: Physical observations must differ and have a useful declared time separation.
This initial screen requires identical release and pipeline version.
Scientific screening requires full CWAVE/CBAND calibration data.
Source and calibration archive URLs and verified file identities are required.
Unknown active flag bits must be investigated.
Coordinate arithmetic check; this does not measure absolute alignment.
Both observations need common unflagged and calibrated support.
Engineering screening threshold across all common supported pixels; not equivalence of spectral response functions.

limitations: Engineering feasibility screen only. No validated motion, photometry, or discovery.
Thresholds are provisional engineering choices, not NASA standards.
WCS reprojection does not establish reference-source alignment.
